facts_verified.claim: DNS preparation durably consumes one mission-global attempt before the workspace-local marker and sole resolver call; it revalidates mission, campaign winner, claim age, review window, and control-root identity without provider HTTP, TCP, or secret access.

The V2 runtime performs zero DNS and one direct socket connection to the selected numeric IP, with no retry or failover, exact peer checks, hostname SNI, and binding-expiry checks immediately before socket creation and throughout dispatch admission.

TTL is clamped to mission, campaign, usable-window, and kickoff-minus-five-minutes ceilings; owner-pack completion returns NETWORK_BINDING_EXPIRED when appropriate.
